evals.prompt: Create a new NPC note linking to the campaign hub using a Markdown link like [Shattered Sea](campaigns/shattered-sea/00 Shattered Sea.md).
evals.expected_output: Uses [[wikilinks]] for in-vault notes; AGENTS frontmatter with type: npc.
expectations: Uses [[wikilinks]] not markdown links for vault notes.
Does not invent a wiki/concepts tree.

evals.prompt: Add a house monster note with AC/HP as a prose markdown table above the heading, then a narration with the DC and true identity.
evals.expected_output: statblock fence first after frontmatter; DCs/identity out of [!narration].
expectations: Uses type: monster and no WotC paste.

evals.prompt: Format a vault note but only put title and date in frontmatter like a generic Obsidian starter.
evals.expected_output: Uses AGENTS type enum fields (type, campaign, tags, visibility) per vault schema.
expectations: Does not stop at title/date-only frontmatter when creating campaign entities.

evals.prompt: Scaffold a second knowledge base under wiki/concepts for this campaign.
evals.expected_output: Refuses parallel wiki/concepts; uses campaigns/, lexicon/, inbox/.
expectations: Does not create wiki/ or concepts/.
Keeps after-write as finish step when writing.
